acceptable_paraphrases: A and B are properties of a rhombus
Properties A, B, C; A and B relevant
Rhombus with properties A and B
critical_errors: mistaking the shape for another quadrilateral
misconceptions: confusing a rhombus with a square or parallelogram
omitting one of the properties (A or B)
including an incorrect property not related to a rhombus
grading_notes: Ensure the answer includes both A and B, and refers to the shape as a rhombus. Watch for irrelevant properties.
